data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The preference is indefensible on strict Popperian terms, revealing a fundamental fracture in his system: one can be a consistent Popperian in the lab (falsifying), but not in the world (acting), forcing a schism between the philosopher and the citizen.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If Popper successfully unified these domains in his later works.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If 'acting' can be redefined to fit within System A.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the schism is acceptable to working scientists.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Embrace the contradiction as a feature, not a bug.
